claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Noetic readouts may remain valid on the Stage 9 fixture, but this colloquialism realization fixture did not establish that canonical Noetic phrases produce the matching hidden-state readout under the locked probe.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Pythia-160M's hidden states for canonical natural-language Noetic colloquialisms are readable by the Stage 9 Noetic probe above the preregistered gates, supporting the η→ε realization route for Noetic language.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, Noetic clusters, 40-Element hard-partner resolution, raw CAS-symbol understanding, free-form generation control, or cross-model generality from Stage 28B.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 28B tests single Noetic colloquial phrases on Pythia-160M. It does not test Noetic clusters, full TKS formulas, component-localized covers, exact neurons, or open-ended generation control.

formal_anchor: η→ε bridge framing: colloquialisms are readable realization language (ε-side) rather than raw CAS symbols or static W_U projections. The probe tests whether the realized phrase re-enters the hidden-state Noetic readout (η-side).

gates.criterion: Stage 9 activation artifact matches the preregistered local replacement contract used by Stage 24B.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: Noetic probe test accuracy is at least 0.50 on the 10-way collapsed Stage 9 task.
gates.name: probe_floor

gates.criterion: Colloquial phrase exact Noetic accuracy is at least 0.45 and exact-binomial p<0.05 against 10-way chance.
gates.name: realization_exact_accuracy

gates.criterion: Mean target probability is at least 0.15, i.e. +0.05 over 10-way chance.
gates.name: target_probability_lift

gates.criterion: Top-2 Noetic accuracy is at least 0.65.
gates.name: top2_accuracy

gates.criterion: For rows whose Noetic has a formal involution partner, target probability beats partner probability on at least 0.60 of rows.
gates.name: involution_partner_margin

method: Commit this pre-registration before any Stage 28B result artifact is generated.
Collapse the Stage 9 40-Element labels into the same 10 Noetic labels used in Stage 28A.
Fit the locked focus-token layer-5 Noetic probe on the existing Stage 9 activation artifact.
Construct a balanced 40-row colloquialism fixture: four natural-language phrases per Noetic class.
Run Pythia-160M forward on each carrier sentence and capture the layer-5 hidden state at the first token overlapping the phrase span.
Score each captured state with the locked Noetic probe.
Evaluate exact accuracy, top-2 accuracy, mean target probability lift over chance, and target-vs-involution-partner margins.
Report per-Noetic rows and failures for audit. Human readability of phrases is not a scoring gate because the fixture is locked natural language.
motivation: Static output-embedding sonar failed to resolve most hard local Noetic contrasts. Stage 28B tests a different route: feed the model natural-language colloquialisms that realize Noetic operators and read the resulting hidden states with the existing Stage 9 Noetic probe.
